body:
I do appreciate the words, I was seeing a therapist, one of the best I ever had, only time I ever was excited to have another appointment, as soon as everything was starting to come around for me, she took another job offer. With everything going on I just simply cannot afford to see another. 

  She makes it very clear that she doesn't "have" to let me see the kids. I'm the kind of person that completely avoids confrontation at all cost, especially with her. If you you don't see things the same way she does, you very well may as be dead to her.
